content:
1. What is the most common cause of hypoparathyroidism?
A. Autoimmune destruction of the parathyroid glands
B. Genetic mutations affecting the parathyroid glands
C. Surgical removal of the parathyroid glands
D. Radiation therapy to the neck area

Answer: A. Autoimmune destruction of the parathyroid glands
